P_0x001CA9.en: Desert-raised surface dweller, pilot of the Elemental Soulgady. Finds his place only through battle, yet seeks peace his own way. Skilled at gathering intel; sometimes acts alone for it.

P_0x002CE3.en: A demon priest of the destruction god Sarva Volkruss. Polite but cold and merciless. Works with Shu to prepare Volkruss's revival.

P_0x008A4B.en: AI researcher who developed "AI-0," a high-performance combat AI. Former instructor at the Federation Army officers' academy; Aqua Centrum was her student.

P_0x00A3C2.en: A Gaia Sabers scientist. Studied <Aerogater> materials at <DC>, then used the data to develop metal cells called <Machine Cell>. Also developed the <Geim System>.

P_0x00CFED.en: Brilliant scientist, ex-<EOTI Organization>, now makes weapons for Zentl Project. Also designed the Granzon.

U_0x0171A6.en: A highly mobile wind <Elemental> built for hit-and-run. Standard armament trails other <Elemental>s, so weak pilots can't unlock its full power. Output is stable and its spirit accepts almost any pilot - hence the mass-produced Gadyful. Its spirit is Soleid of the Sandstorm, a low-rank wind spirit.

U_0x0054BB.en: Third unit (SRG-03-3) of the newest Grungusts, from the <Tesla Leicht Institute> under the <SRX Project>, unfrozen after the <L5 Campaign>. Based on the Grungust (Type-1) and specialized for melee, with the series' highest output and attack power. Splits into the G-Raptor fighter (upper body) and G-Bison tank (lower body), one pilot each. After the <Inspector Incident>, it gained the <T-LINK System>, a <Tesla Drive>, and the Type-3 Shishioh Blade (<S.Unit>-size).

U_0x00B4DF.en: Lion's successor from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; 'Relion' = 'Refined Lion.' Human-type arms wield varied weapons like the Guarlion. A multirole <Armored Module>: stronger, easier to handle, maintain, and produce than the Lion.
